description: Change a Matrix context's name, description, structural profile (list_profiles, kind structural) or embed_images (embed graphics pages automatically after the text; needs a search model with an image encoder). Only the fields you pass change; null clears an assignment. To move a context to another search model use setup_embedding_model with reindex_contexts.

embed_images.description: Embed graphics pages automatically after the text chunks (embedding job). Catch up any time with embed_page_images.

name: update_context
